subject: Temporarily raise QPS window — surcharge tiers, invoice timing, and commit offset
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom@brightcart.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightcart.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term QPS window for launch week — need pricing and limits

Hi Hannah,

We’re ramping a feature launch on 2026-03-18 that will spike API traffic for a ~48 hour window. Estimated steady QPS for that window is ~420 requests/sec (p50 payload ~1.2k tokens). We expect a short peak for a few hours hitting ~1k QPS.

Can Redwood support a temporary headroom increase for that window and what would the surcharge look like? Two specific asks: 1) a pricing matrix for transient QPS tiers / overrun (how much per token or per-request) and 2) whether any of that can be offset against our existing commit (we have an annual reserved capacity agreement, order #RC-2042). Also want to confirm invoice timing — can you defer any true-up to the month-end billing cycle so we have time to reconcile?

I’ve attached our traffic plan and the rough timing. We’re happy to sign a short addendum/PO if needed.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Infrastructure
BrightCart

Attachment: brightcart-launch-traffic-plan.pdf (PDF, 230KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@brightcart.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term QPS window for launch week — need pricing and limits

Hi Tom,

Thanks for the plan — looks straightforward and congrats on the launch. We can support a short-window uplift but want to align on three things: surcharge tiers, commit offset, and operational readiness. High-level proposal below:

- Temporary uplift window: 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC (48 hours).
- Surge tiers: up to 2x baseline (<=420 QPS) — no surcharge; 2x-5x (421–2100 QPS) — surcharge tier A; >5x (>2100 QPS) — surcharge tier B (emergency).
- Pricing: Tier A surcharge = +20% on published per-token rate for the uplifted tokens; Tier B surcharge = +50% on published per-token rate. We can also offer a blended per-MTU (million-token) uplift quote in the provisional spreadsheet if you prefer absolute numbers.
- Commit offset: we can credit up to 40% of verified surge overrun against next quarter’s committed capacity if you increase your committed monthly throughput by at least 15% for the next 3 months (amendment required).
- Invoice timing: we will bill the uplift usage on the regular monthly invoice. For this exceptional window we can postpone the invoice posting until the month-end true-up cycle to give you time to reconcile (no additional finance fees).

Operational asks: please provide final peak-hour start/end times 24 hours before the window. We’ll run a quick smoke test and increase autoscaling headroom on the dedicated pool. Laura — please validate OC/ops capacity and confirm latency SLOs for the 1k QPS short spike. Karthik — can you confirm the routing/fallback policy if capacity becomes constrained?

I attached a provisional quote with tier math; if you’re comfortable we’ll draft a short addendum and PO template.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachment: provisional-uptift-quote.xlsx (Excel, 14KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term QPS window for launch week — need pricing and limits

Hannah — quick internal check.

On Mon, Mar 9, 2026 at 10:02 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Operational asks: please provide final peak-hour start/end times 24 hours before the window. We’ll run a quick smoke test and increase autoscaling headroom on the dedicated pool. Laura — please validate OC/ops capacity and confirm latency SLOs for the 1k QPS short spike. Karthik — can you confirm the routing/fallback policy if capacity becomes constrained?

We have capacity in the dedicated pool to absorb the 420 QPS baseline and short spikes to ~1k QPS for the 48 hour window assuming no long tail sustained >1k for more than 3 hours. Two notes:
1) If traffic hits >1k QPS sustained beyond 3 hours we will automatically route proportion of requests to a lower-cost shared pool (higher latency variance) unless customer wants to commit to a temporary reserved node add-on (fast path).
2) Latency SLO: 95th <= 220ms for the dedicated pool at 1k QPS with current model (base gen). If the customer pins a heavier model or long seq lengths expect SLO to slip; we’ll need to test.

Operational recommendation: accept Hannah’s surcharge tiers + include an explicit emergency add-on opt-in (one-click PO) if they want guaranteed exclusive headroom for absolute spikes. Laura — can you confirm the emergency add-on pricing floor?

Karthik
Platform Ops
From: Tom Alvarez <tom@brightcart.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightcart.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term QPS window for launch week — need pricing and limits

Hannah — we’re good with the proposed structure. Two quick confirmations:
1) We accept Tier A/B surcharge bands as described. Please include the blended per-MTU numbers in the addendum so our finance team can sign.
2) We’d like the option to purchase the emergency reserved node add-on if we see sustained >1k QPS during the window — please include PO language for a 24-hour ramp and a fixed per-hour price.

Please send an addendum + PO template and we’ll get it to procurement. We’ll confirm final peak start time 24 hours before the window.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Infrastructure
BrightCart
